ValidationRule.description: Dissatisfaction with Onboarder selected but Reason for dissatisfaction is blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Dissatisfaction with Onboarder"), ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Dissatisfaction with Onboarding Experience") ), ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), ISBLANK( Reason_for_Dissatisfaction__c ) )
